result.instructions: Tools for Navixy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our vehicles are moving right now, and which are parked?"; "Which devices in our workspace are offline since yesterday?"; "Show the trips and stops of asset 42 for yesterday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Navixy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run navixy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run navixy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run navixy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. navixy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: navixy_get_workspace
tools.title: Get the workspace
tools.description: Show the workspace that the API key reaches: its id, title, whether it is active, and its organization id. Good first call to confirm the connection. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.workspace.

tools.name: navixy_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List the assets (vehicles, equipment and other tracked objects) in the workspace, with their type and primary device. Filter by title or asset type. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.assets.

title_contains.description: Only assets whose title contains this text.

after.description: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page, to read the next page.

tools.name: navixy_get_asset
tools.title: Get an asset
tools.description: Get one asset by id: its type, its primary device with status, and the asset groups it belongs to. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.asset.

asset_id.description: The asset ID (from a list tool).

tools.name: navixy_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List the GPS trackers and sensors in the workspace, with their status, model, vendor and the asset they are linked to. Filter by title, identifier (such as an IMEI) or status. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.devices.

title_contains.description: Only devices whose title contains this text.

identifier_contains.description: Only devices whose identifier (for example an IMEI) contains this text.

after.description: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page, to read the next page.

tools.name: navixy_get_device
tools.title: Get a device
tools.description: Get one device by id: its status, model, vendor, type, identifiers (such as IMEI) and the asset it is linked to. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.device.

device_id.description: The device ID (from a list tool).

tools.name: navixy_list_asset_groups
tools.title: List asset groups
tools.description: List the asset groups of the workspace (typed, colour-coded collections of assets for fleet segmentation). Filter by title. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.assetGroups.

title_contains.description: Only groups whose title contains this text.

after.description: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page, to read the next page.

tools.name: navixy_list_geo_objects
tools.title: List geofences and points of interest
tools.description: List the geofences, points of interest and routes of the workspace, with their type. The geometry is not returned. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.geoObjects.

title_contains.description: Only geo objects whose title contains this text.

after.description: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page, to read the next page.

annotations.title: List geofences and points of interest

tools.name: navixy_list_asset_states
tools.title: List live asset states
tools.description: List the live state of assets: last position, speed, motion (moving, stopped, parked), connectivity (online, offline, never reported) and recent readings of the primary device. Use the filters to find, for example, all offline vehicles. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.assetStates.

title_contains.description: Only assets whose title contains this text.

connectivity_status.description: Only assets with one of these connectivity statuses.

motion_status.description: Only assets with one of these motion statuses.

after.description: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page, to read the next page.

tools.name: navixy_get_asset_state
tools.title: Get the live state of an asset
tools.description: Get the live state of one asset: position, speed, motion, connectivity, readings and recent events of every linked device. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.assetState.

asset_id.description: The asset ID (from a list tool).

annotations.title: Get the live state of an asset

tools.name: navixy_get_device_state
tools.title: Get the live state of a device
tools.description: Get the live state of one device (GPS tracker or sensor): position, speed, motion, connectivity, readings and recent events. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.deviceState.

device_id.description: The device ID (from a list tool).

annotations.title: Get the live state of a device

tools.name: navixy_get_asset_timeline
tools.title: Get the trips and stops of an asset
tools.description: Get the trips (tracks) and stops of an asset in a time range, with distance, driving time, stop time and the start and end points. Route points are not returned. The range is limited by the vendor. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.assetTimeline.

asset_id.description: The asset ID (from a list tool).

from.description: Start or end, ISO 8601 with a zone, for example 2026-11-24T00:00:00Z.

to.description: Start or end, ISO 8601 with a zone, for example 2026-11-24T00:00:00Z.

min_stop_duration.description: Shortest stop to report, as an ISO 8601 duration, for example PT5M. Default set by Navixy.

stop_radius.description: Radius in metres within which a device counts as stopped.

moving_speed_threshold.description: Speed in km/h above which a device counts as moving.

annotations.title: Get the trips and stops of an asset
